summary: ci-perf-slot tests can retain attributed, atomic fixture receipts outside disposable test trees

schema.detail: Opt-in diagnostic JSON receipts are not stored application data.

rules.detail: The optional CI_PERF_SLOT_RECEIPT_DIR sink must be a real, privately writable directory outside source trees and st-test disposable roots. Directory-fd-relative writes preserve an incomplete started receipt until atomic finalization. Receipts include invocation/source/caller attribution, runtime host and UTC timestamps, stdout evidence, separate live and lifecycle peak samples, fixture limits and final unit/cgroup counts. Live peak read failures fail closed.

compatibility.detail: Without the sink, evidence continues on stdout and helpers require no git working directory. Sink and validator checks remain active with Python optimization enabled. Validation requires a named admitted scope containing the caller, both drained fixtures in that scope's parent slice, valid peaks and consistent manager readbacks. The no-user-manager skip instead requires null admission and no fixtures. Final scans cover app.slice, builds.slice and each actual fixture parent, deduplicated and recorded; validation requires each fixture parent among those roots. An absent lane root counts as zero; other inspection errors fail closed. SIGKILL leaves an incomplete receipt. st-test preserves the receipt setting and exports resolved disposable roots.

recovery.detail: Unset CI_PERF_SLOT_RECEIPT_DIR to disable durable receipt transport.
